headline: Sensex choppy in volatile session while financials lead early gains and HAL drops post Q2 results

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty experienced volatile trading after early gains led by banking and financial stocks.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices boosted early market sentiment.
M&M, Nestle, and PowerGrid emerged as the main drags on the benchmark indices.
Post-Q2 earnings reactions led to mixed movements in major single stocks like HAL.
whatHappening: Reliance announced a $4.6 billion coal gasification project planned in Andhra Pradesh.
HAL reported a 16% rise in Q2 profit, but its share price fell 4% during the trading session.
IRCTC, Oil India, Ola Electric, and Vodafone Idea were in focus for their Q2 earnings announcements.
RBI is proposing a ban on private equity firms controlling multiple non-banking financial companies.
summary: Indian stock markets traded choppy and flat following early gains driven by bank stocks, foreign fund inflows, and lower crude prices. Reliance announced a major $4.6 billion gasification project in Andhra Pradesh. HAL shares fell 4% despite a 16% jump in Q2 net profit as multiple companies remained in focus for quarterly results.
